title: Gur Panth Prakash Closes With Devotional Assurance

blocks.text: The closing passage turns directly toward the reader and listener. Its promise is devotional rather than political: those who read and hear this account are invited toward Sikh commitment through the True Guru’s grace.
The work then names itself with solemn completion, presenting Gur Panth Prakash as a finished and truthful illumination of the Panth to be read, heard, and transmitted onward.

The final note also preserves the author's own situated identity in relation to Sham Singh and Mirankot. The book closes not in abstraction, but in lineage, memory, and a blessing on continued recitation.
